prompt.behavior: Fabric and construction: light 160gsm cotton-polyester blend jersey, thin and smooth with a matte, slightly dry synthetic-blend hand; in light gray it shows a fine heathered melange. The fabric drapes lightly and follows the body, forming many small soft wrinkles at the waist and under the arms, and it resists deep creasing. Clean narrow 1x1 ribbed collar sewn without external topstitching, lying flat and round; shoulder-to-shoulder tape; set-in shoulder seam exactly on the shoulder point; double-needle hems at sleeves and body. Movement: light and quick — the fabric shifts easily with the pose, sleeves ride up a little when the arm is raised, and pinching the hem produces thin crisp folds.
prompt.fit: Fit on the model (size M on a 1.84 m, 84 kg man): body length 72 cm ending at the hip, flat chest width 54 cm giving a close regular fit that lightly follows the chest without being tight, shoulder width 46 cm with the seam on the shoulder point, sleeve length 18 cm ending mid-bicep.
